nodes.text: On this special day, we thought it would be nice to view Mother's Day from the most important perspective of all...
A mother!

nodes.title: Mother's Day
nodes.subtitle: A mother's job is never easy...

nodes.text: A beautiful morning dawns across Centerscore...
The sky is clear, the birds are chirping...
And everyone is still in their beds...
Everyone, that is, except for one hardworking mother...
It's just after six in the morning, and Cathy gently rocks a wailing baby to sleep.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh, baby Kara... You don't want to cry the `entire` night, do you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, baby Kara... You don't want to cry the [color=#3b78e2][i]entire[/i][/color] night, do you?

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: Wahh! Wah! Wah!

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: Wah! Wah! Wah!
Cathy sighs.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Let's try another song...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: { Go to sleep... Go to sleep... {

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: { Go to sleep, Little Baby... Go to sleep... {
A few minutes in, Kara at last drops into a peaceful slumber...
Cathy places her in the crib and kisses her, whispering as she walks away.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: That's good...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: But it would have been a lot better eight hours ago!
All at once, the door opens, and Horace bursts in!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Happy Mother's Day, Cathy!
Baby Kara starts crying again.

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: Wah! Wah! Wah!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh, Horace...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Sorry. Since it's Mother's Day... I'll take care of her.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You couldn't have done that when she was screaming in the middle of the night?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: I slept right through it! You know how I am!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: When you can sleep through enemies throwing hand grenades at your shelter during all odd hours of the day, then you can sleep through anything!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Horace, did you just call our daughter a hand grenade?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Uh, er, `no,` dear... I said she was `like` a hand grenade...
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, er, [color=#e23b3b][i]no,[/i][/color] dear... I said she was [color=#e23b3b][i]like[/i][/color] a hand grenade...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Not helping.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Right! Well, why don't you go back to bed?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You're assuming I went to bed in the first place...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Just go and enjoy your Mother's Day breakfast, er...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Breakfast?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: You know, the one the twins like to make for you every year?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You mean, the breakfast that blows up our kitchen every year?!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Yeah... `That` one...
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... [color=#e23b3b][i]That[/i][/color] one...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I have to stop them!
Cathy runs downstairs to the kitchen as fast as she can...
And breathes a sigh of relief when she sees the kitchen sitting in tranquil silence.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: They're not awake yet... Which means I have time to hide everything!
Cathy starts scooping up all the kitchen knives, the cheese grater, the meat tenderizer, and the apple slicer, and tucks them into a cabinet with a lock on it.
She then unplugs the stove, the dishwasher, and the blender, and as a final coup de gras, she hides the matches.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Whew!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Why is it that even though I've successfully kept them from making breakfast, I still feel a sense of foreboding?
And that's when she hears...
KABOOM!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: And `there` it is...
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]there[/i][/color] it is...

nodes.text: A couple minutes later, Cathy stands on the front lawn, apologizing to the neighbors and making a statement to the police.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Officer Monte, let me get this straight... You found my children standing in front of our neighbor's grill holding a box of matches?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am. And that was only a few minutes after an explosion knocked out the McGraws' outdoor grill.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Unfortunately, that does sound like my children...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: So do you think there was any intent to harm?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Harm? No! Kay and Kel would never try to harm anyone.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Officer Monte, they're just kids...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Kids with a criminal record as thick as my thigh!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: That's... Odd.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We weren't trying to burn Mr. McGraw's house down!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We're just trying to make our mommy a good breakfast! For Mother's Day!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah! For Mother's Day!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Officer Monte, haven't you ever burned something on accident when you tried to do something for your mom on Mother's Day?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Kid, the only thing that would appease my mother on her name day was the hide of a wild bear...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Every year, my brothers and I would venture into the woods, our knives sharpened, our hunting senses sharp...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Officer Monte, I'm going to have to stop you right there... Thank you for investigating this matter so thoroughly...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: But if we promise to reimburse Mr. McGraw for the damage, and if my children aren't being arrested, do you think I could get on with my day?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Of course, ma'am.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But you'd best be careful.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I'll take it from here.
As Monte leaves, Cathy turns to the twins.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Why did you two have to blow up our neighbor's kitchen?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You know that the McGraws explicitly told you never to come near their house...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Ever since the burning tree house incident, they've been really jumpy about fire, and now you go and do this?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: It's not our fault! We just wanted your Mother's Day breakfast to be an awesome surprise, so we went across the street to borrow Mr. McGraw's grill!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: How were we supposed to know the difference between lighter fluid and vegetable oil?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: They both come in bottles!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: But we did make something for you... You see?
Kay produces a blackened circle from behind her back. Cathy sighs.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I believe this is stealing evidence...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I think it's an English muffin.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Happy Mother's Day?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Happy Mother's Day!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: At least you two are very sweet. Come here...
Cathy wraps them both in a large hug.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Why don't you girls get cleaned up so you won't be late for school?
The twins scamper off.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I hope their wild streak gets better with age...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: But what am I saying, they're just going to be teenagers...
Cathy surveys the damage across the street, shakes her head, and goes inside.
Cathy begins putting the kitchen utensils back in their regular places...
When Howard walks in.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey Mom?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Yes, dear? I hope the explosion didn't wake you up...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My, uh, interview with the recruiter from Kingston's today.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh, that's right...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I'm so proud of you, Howard. I know you're going to do just great.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, Mom. But I was wondering if you could help me...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Of course, dear...
In Howard's room a minute later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Orange tie or blue tie?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Orange is one of Kingston's colors, but blue looks better on me.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I'd go with a black bowtie.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You sure?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Yes, I am. You want to look your absolute best.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, Mom, do you think my interview will go okay?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You're a nice, caring, and well-spoken young man. You'll be great! Don't think Kingston is above you.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: ...No matter what your father says. Don't forget now, okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I won't.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, Mom.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I completely forgot! Happy Mother's Day!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Of course, dear.
Suddenly, their fire alarm goes off!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I `told` them to `get dressed...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]told[/i][/color] them to [color=#3b78e2][i]get dressed...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Don't you worry about this, Howard. Just get yourself to school. Good luck!
Cathy runs downstairs into the kitchen...
Where Horace has four pans on the stovetop... Two of them on fire!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Oh, come on! You're telling me that `wasn't` vegetable oil?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, come on! You're telling me that [color=#e23b3b][i]wasn't[/i][/color] vegetable oil?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: `What on earth are you doing?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What on earth are you doing?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Happy Mother's Day?
Cathy throws lids on both fires, reaches for the fire extinguisher underneath the table, and blasts it full on the stove until nothing but black smoke and white mist can be seen.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: And here's why I think the twins get it from `you...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And here's why I think the twins get it from [color=#3b78e2][i]you...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Which means they must get their natural beauty from you.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Horace, just try not to burn our house down while I'm at the PTA meeting this afternoon, would you?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: ...No promises.
That afternoon, at the Parent-Teacher Association meeting...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Happy Mother's Day, ladies! This session of the PTA will come to order.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Now, are there any last minute comments before we talk about the budget for next year?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Pliny
nodes.text: What I'm trying to figure out is...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Pliny
nodes.text: Who authorized spending our entire budget to host a gigantic paintball tournament?

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: Thank you, Pamela! I've been wondering that forever!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: You mean, the Spartan Games? I'll admit I had some part in approving it...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: But that was purely for the sake of school unity...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Of course, I do know that I wasn't the `only one` for it...
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course, I do know that I wasn't the [color=#3b78e2][i]only one[/i][/color] for it...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: What better way to show students' character than by setting them loose in the wild with paintball guns?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Pliny
nodes.text: It feels more like a rehashing of the Fist Club argument that you started up here last year...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: We don't talk about Fist Club!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Pliny
nodes.text: Cathy, what do you think?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Ladies, perhaps it's best if we focus on the future rather than the past...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I, for one, would much rather talk about what we're going to do about the jagged fault running through our school than the silly game we held a couple months ago...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: As always, Howard's mother makes an `excellent point... `
nodes.text_bbcode: As always, Howard's mother makes an [color=#3b78e2][i]excellent point... [/i][/color]

nodes.text: Cathy comes out of the PTA meeting, muttering to herself.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I worry about the state of our public educational system...
As she crosses the parking lot, she can hear quiet sniffling coming from one of the temporary classrooms.
She rounds the corner and finds $ZOE sitting down on a curb, crying.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, hi...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: $ZOE, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, uh, yeah... I'm totally fine.
$ZOE wipes frantically at her eyes.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Uh-huh.
Cathy searches in her purse for a tissue and hands it to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Do you want to talk?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well... I don't know if I should...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I understand if you don't want to talk to your boyfriend's mom, but...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's not that... It's just...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's about Howard. He's... He's leaving for college...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm so sad about it that I just don't know what to do.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I want him to do well at the Kingston interview, I really do, but if he goes...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You'll miss him so much that your heart will hurt.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I know how you feel.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Trust me, I do.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How can you stand it?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Because I love him, and it's good for him to go.
$ZOE nods and smiles sadly.
Cathy digs another tissue out of her bag and hands it to her.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Can I give you a ride home?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, it's okay... I have some things to think about...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And... Thank you. You really are a great mom.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You take care, $ZOE.
Cathy arrives home, exhausted. She sets her purse down in the foyer and looks around the dark house.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: ...I guess I should be glad no one `is` cooking, but...
nodes.text_bbcode: ...I guess I should be glad no one [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] cooking, but...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Hello? Is anyone home?
She closes the door and enters the dining room.
The lights are turned low, but in the center, Cathy finds an elegant dinner set up with candles and a large bouquet of beautiful flowers.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: `SURPRISE!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]SURPRISE![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Surprise!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Surprise!

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: Sah-pah! Sah-pah!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Happy Mother's Day, mom!
Cathy finds herself in a sea of hugs.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You guys... You didn't have to do this...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It was the least they could do after this morning...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah, we made dinner all by ourselves!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Well, maybe Howard helped a little bit...
Her family around her, Cathy smiles.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh, I'm so lucky to have all of you.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I love you, Mommy!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Count me in!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Now... Anyone hungry?
Aww, isn't that sweet? We hope you enjoyed our short story!
To all mothers everywhere... We wish you a `Happy Mother's Day!`
nodes.text_bbcode: To all mothers everywhere... We wish you a [b]Happy Mother's Day![/b]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And when I find out the person responsible...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They are going to be `so` dead!
nodes.text_bbcode: They are going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] dead!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But who would do this to you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hannah `did` seem really full of herself...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hannah [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] seem really full of herself...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But posting all your texts to a gossip blog? That seems like too much work for Hannah...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're right. It'd have to be someone mean, someone with a `real` chip on their shoulder...
nodes.text_bbcode: You're right. It'd have to be someone mean, someone with a [color=#3b78e2][i]real[/i][/color] chip on their shoulder...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think I know...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Jessica.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Jessica.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're right, cuz.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe she would stoop so low!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She didn't have to go after you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of course she did! I'm your cousin. She wants to get back at you, so she got to me too!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, but... It's not fair...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sometimes people don't play fair...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How am I supposed to be flattered about this?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Someone took everything I felt for Nick and aired it out like dirty laundry!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm pissed!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... I just meant... Aside from the fact that it's out in public, everything you've done with Nick was sweet and heartfelt...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You care for each other a lot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And the only people who are supposed to know that are `me` and `him!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And the only people who are supposed to know that are [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] and [color=#3b78e2][i]him![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I am so mad!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You heard me! This is awful and infuriating! I'd be so mad!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is a huge breach of your privacy!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You are `so` right!
nodes.text_bbcode: You are [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] right!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm `so` angry!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] angry!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Tomorrow, I'm going to have a `serious talk` with her!
nodes.text_bbcode: Tomorrow, I'm going to have a [color=#3b78e2][i]serious talk[/i][/color] with her!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That'll show her...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? Do you think that's too mean?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, it's great! Be tough! Tell her off! Take her down!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Tomorrow. Right now, I just want to go home.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: At least she can't get to me there...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah... Are you going to be okay? Should I walk you home? I can skip swimming...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And have Coach Kessler chew you out? No, I'll be fine. I'll catch you later.
$ZOE and Sam start to head off campus for their respective destinations...
...And that's when $ZOE notices the whispering.
Various groups of students cluster together, huddled around something $ZOE can't quite see.
Laughter rises from many of the groups, and when people walk by Sam, they point and stare.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, is it me, or is something weird going on?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, everyone's acting strange.
$ZOE suddenly feels her phone buzz in her bag. She takes it out and finds a text.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's weird. I don't recognize this number...
Sam peers over at $ZOE's phone.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I wonder if this is what everyone's talking about...
$ZOE opens the text and finds a link to a website called 'The Dirty Dish'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It looks like it's some kind of gossip blog where people can post stuff about Twin Branches students...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hmm... This top post is some kind of text log...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That... That's me! That's my stuff!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That top post is a log of my texts with Nick! It's all stolen from my phone!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They're supposed to be only for me and him!
Some girls walk past Sam and giggle.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey, Sam... Have you been hanging out with `sweet emo cakes` lately?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, Sam... Have you been hanging out with [color=#3b78e2][i]sweet emo cakes[/i][/color] lately?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Or do you like it better when he calls you his `hot Sammy snowflake`?
nodes.text_bbcode: Or do you like it better when he calls you his [color=#3b78e2][i]hot Sammy snowflake[/i][/color]?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't make me slap that grin off your face! Because I will!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam!
$ZOE grabs Sam's arm as Hannah approaches them.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Way to go, Sam! I didn't know you had it in you to `sneak into the nurse's office` just to make out with Hottie McEmo Guy!
nodes.text_bbcode: Way to go, Sam! I didn't know you had it in you to [color=#3b78e2][i]sneak into the nurse's office[/i][/color] just to make out with Hottie McEmo Guy!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Go away, Hannah!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Aw, come on... I really do think it's kind of cute that you love him `more than meaty pizza.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Aw, come on... I really do think it's kind of cute that you love him [color=#3b78e2][i]more than meaty pizza.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Go away, Hannah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Go away, Hannah![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And quickly, before I let go!
Hannah leaves them, and $ZOE releases Sam's arm.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huh... So you and Nick broke into the nurse's office?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes! And `no one` is supposed to know! All that stuff is supposed to be `private!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes! And [color=#3b78e2][i]no one[/i][/color] is supposed to know! All that stuff is supposed to be [color=#3b78e2][i]private![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is so embarrassing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam... It's not embarrassing...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You sure?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, no offense, cuz, but you stink. The bikini's got to be better than staying in those all day.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't wear a bikini around school!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Principal Shapiro almost kicked me out last time!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It's your funeral.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe no one will notice?
During lunch...
$ZOE sits down with Howard at the popular table...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE, what...
Howard's eyes widen.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Smells?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no... You can tell?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's kind of hard not to. Seriously, do you smell that? Do you think it's a skunk or something? Like a really sweaty, dying skunk?
Howard looks under the table, and $ZOE collects her lunch.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Maybe? You know, I think I'm just going to hang out in the library...
$ZOE finds a table in the back of the room and shrinks against the wall.
Slowly but certainly, the tables around her start to empty. $ZOE can hear the whispers of people as they walk out...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Ugh, what is that unholy, unnatural stink?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The sulfur and brimstone of the dark caves of Mordarkor?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It smells like that time I threw up mushroom soup!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No, it smells like the old mascot costume... Let's go outside... I could use a tan.
After school, in the parking lot...
$ZOE runs into the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE! The girls were just so sad you got academic probation, they wanted to give you a huge hug!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love hugs!
$ZOE quickly steps away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, that's really thoughtful, but no!

nodes.speaker: Jessica

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Phew!
$ZOE slips into the library for study hall...

Ryan and Phil sit down at the same table.

nodes.text: If you know what's good for you, you won't put your fingers on anything.

After school, in the parking lot, $ZOE runs into the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What `are` you wearing?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] you wearing?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A bikini. I didn't have much of a `choice.`
nodes.text_bbcode: A bikini. I didn't have much of a [color=#3b78e2][i]choice.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Awesome.

nodes.text: What would you know about that?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh... Nothing!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Almost` nothing at all. See you later, $ZOE. If you ever get off probation.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Almost[/i][/color] nothing at all. See you later, $ZOE. If you ever get off probation.

nodes.text: So, uh, how'd wearing that bikini go for you?

nodes.text: So what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.text: What am I going to do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just these smelly gym clothes...
$ZOE roots through her gym bag and pulls out a bikini.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And this bikini... I guess I haven't cleaned this bag out since summer...

nodes.text: The choice seems obvious...

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ah!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ahhhh!

nodes.text: Geez, you guys, stop that! $ZOE, what is `wrong` with you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Geez, you guys, stop that! $ZOE, what is [color=#3b78e2][i]wrong[/i][/color] with you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My locker's empty!
$ZOE nearly cries out in panic but stops herself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yelling isn't going to help me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Guys, my locker's empty!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: At any rate, it seems like you know your academic topics well enough...

nodes.text: Which means the impossible has happened!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee

nodes.text: I'll do some digging, and we'll see if we can sort everything out, okay?

nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Unfortunately, you still are on academic probation until we straighten things out with your grades.

nodes.text: But hopefully we can get this fixed before it goes on your permanent record!

nodes.text: Ha! Wouldn't that be awful?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes it would!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, try not to worry. It only affects your chances of getting into college. Go back to class now!
Ms. Lee shoos $ZOE out of her office just as the bell rings.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is going on?!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: At any rate, you failed!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: $ZOE, I'm a psychologist. I know what it's called when a person denies the reality of a situation...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Denial?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: `Crazypants!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Crazypants![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Your grades have suffered terribly this last quarter. I'm going to have to schedule a conference with your teachers and guardian.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, I'm sure this is a mistake!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: There are no mistakes, $ZOE. I told you.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I'll be seeing you at the parent-teacher conference tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Based on these grades, I'm guessing college is out of the question. How do you feel about pizza delivery?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, wait!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: And until further notice, you're suspended from all sports, dances, and other school activities. No more cheerleading for you!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: But try not to let this get you down. Have a nice day, dear!
Ms. Lee shoos $ZOE out of her office just as the bell rings.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is terrible! It's going to be a mess talking to all my teachers! What am I going to do if I don't get into college?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How did this even happen?
$ZOE heads towards her next class when she suddenly sees the cheerleaders talking.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I should probably tell Jessica I can't go to cheerleading today...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So then I told him that red was a hotter color than white... And he just changed his shirt!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Wow, I thought it was hard to get guys to change.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Not if you know how to order them around... Hee hee.
$ZOE walks up to Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh hi, $ZOE! You must be enjoying life outside the mascot costume...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kind of, I guess... Hey, Jessica, can we talk? Alone?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sure.
They step off to the side.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't make it to cheerleading today. I'm on academic probation.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How'd you manage that? You didn't get straight 'F's in one quarter, did you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, I did...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How weird! I always thought you were `smart.`
nodes.text_bbcode: How weird! I always thought you were [color=#3b78e2][i]smart.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Maybe it's karma...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm just asking you to `think` about it... You haven't `wronged` anyone recently, have you?
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm just asking you to [color=#3b78e2][i]think[/i][/color] about it... You haven't [color=#3b78e2][i]wronged[/i][/color] anyone recently, have you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't `think` so...
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't [color=#3b78e2][i]think[/i][/color] so...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Think harder.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... All of my grades dropping to 'F's...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, don't sell yourself short... You got a 'D' in math.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `You` were behind this?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]You[/i][/color] were behind this?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, $ZOE. I didn't say `that...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, $ZOE. I didn't say [color=#3b78e2][i]that...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You practically did! And it's because I showed you up!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Let's get one thing straight... You didn't `show me up.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Let's get one thing straight... You didn't [color=#3b78e2][i]show me up.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I let you win. But I don't let things go that easily.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And have fun trying to prove that I did `anything` to you!
nodes.text_bbcode: And have fun trying to prove that I did [color=#3b78e2][i]anything[/i][/color] to you!

nodes.text: $ZOE starts to speak up, but Jessica turns her back.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Come on, girls... Let's go...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And, $ZOE, we'll try to miss you at practice.
Jessica leads all the cheerleaders away, leaving $ZOE fuming.
A couple minutes later...
$ZOE and Sam talk as they jog laps in the gym for P.E.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Jessica sabotaged your grades?

nodes.text: Yes! I don't know how, but she's totally behind it!

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.text: Because I have no proof! No one's going to believe that Jessica somehow hacked into the school computer and changed my grades!

nodes.text: It sounds stupid, even to me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It'll be all right...

When the P.E. period is over...
Sam and $ZOE file back into the locker room and start changing out of their gym clothes.

nodes.text: Ugh, I'll be glad to get out of these gross clothes.

nodes.text: Someone's been studying her milk cartons...

nodes.text: Your what now?

nodes.text: Wrong!

nodes.text: Looks like someone needs to pay more attention in the P.E. classroom...

nodes.text: Uh... Improving eyesight?

nodes.text: Calcium is a mineral that is best known for...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: It's all right, dear! You don't have to be good at math as long as you're good at sports!

nodes.text: Which brings me to my P.E. question...

nodes.text: Great!

nodes.text: Let's see how you're doing in the most important class of all... P.E.!

nodes.text: Not the right answer, I'm afraid!

nodes.text: Let's see if you do any better in math...

nodes.text: Correct!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Let's see how you do in math...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Irony?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $ZOE, but because your grades are so low, you're being put on academic probation, effective immediately.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ms. Lee, I know this is wrong! It's a mistake, I'm sure!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What can I do to prove to you that the grades in the computer aren't mine?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean, I could go around asking all my teachers to evaluate my performance and give you an accurate grade...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Or you could prove your knowledge of all your subjects to me here and now!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: What better way to prove how you're actually doing than by answering a series of questions related to all your classes?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... Think I preferred my way...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Nonsense! My idea is much more interesting! It's so crazy, it just might work!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Out of curiosity, how often do you say that?

nodes.text: Why, several times a day!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...That's what I thought.

nodes.text: Excellent! It's like a quiz show! Let's begin!

nodes.text: It says here that you're taking English...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I don't know what you're implying, but I don't make mistakes!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Now, I don't know what's going on, but clearly you've made some bad decisions this last quarter.

nodes.text: How far the mighty have fallen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But...

nodes.text: A fraud?

nodes.text: Yeah... What if someone else messed them up?

nodes.text: Do you really think someone hacked into the computer system and changed all your grades?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, think about it, Ms. Lee...

nodes.text: Every quarter before this one, I've received straight 'A's!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, except for that one 'B' in biology I see last year...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I've never done so badly that I've gotten all 'F's!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: That `is` unusual!
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] unusual!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: And I have to admit... The possibility intrigues me...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So can you fix my grades?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Unfortunately, the computer never lies...
At the front, Ms. Prez calls the class to order.

nodes.text: All right class... Before we dive right into an analysis of the novel... $ZOE, Ms. Lee wants to see you.

$ZOE leaves the class.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: New girl... Welcome to your first day of school!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not new...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Oh, I know. For some reason, I just always think of you as 'The New Girl'.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: So why are you here?

nodes.text: Ms. Prez said `you` called `me` into your office...
nodes.text_bbcode: Ms. Prez said [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] called [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] into your office...

nodes.text: Ms. Lee turns to her computer and starts pulling up records.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Oh yes... I remember now. It's about this!
Ms. Lee points to the screen and shows it to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: $ZOE, this is your report card. I just received an alert about it this morning.
$ZOE looks on the screen and sees that her good grades have been replaced with 'D's and 'F's!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?! I have a 'D' in math? No way! And I can't be getting an 'F' in English! Ms. Prez loves me!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, that sounds inappropriate!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I didn't mean...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I don't get paid to listen to what you mean. I get paid to tell you that I'm very disappointed in you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But Ms. Lee... These grades... It must be...

nodes.text: I don't want to ruin Ben's chances just because I don't like his girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's probably better if I stay out of it.

nodes.text: You want to `stay out of it?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You want to [color=#3b78e2][i]stay out of it?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's too late for that! You're right in the middle of it!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you let Ben win, you let Jessica win!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And I know I'm not the only one she stuck her nails in to get to the top!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you figure out you want to do more than 'stay out of it', come find me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good luck!
Taylor shakes her head and leaves $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And here I thought it was going to be a `good` day...
nodes.text_bbcode: And here I thought it was going to be a [color=#3b78e2][i]good[/i][/color] day...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I told Jessica I didn't want to support Ben because I don't know anything about his campaign or what he stands for.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I don't know that much more about your campaign either.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: My goal is to `beat Jessica`... What more do you need to know?
nodes.text_bbcode: My goal is to [color=#3b78e2][i]beat Jessica[/i][/color]... What more do you need to know?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That just proves my point. I'm sorry, but I can't support you right now.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine. I can accept that.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm so relieved!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That doesn't mean I'm happy about it!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The longer you wait, the more ground Ben and Jessica will cover.

nodes.speaker: Taylor

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: When you figure out what you want, come find me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good luck!
Taylor shakes her head and leaves $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And here I thought it was going to at least be a drama-free day...
At that moment, Taylor runs up to Sam and $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, yourself.

nodes.text: $ZOE... Mind if I walk you to class?

nodes.text: Uh, sure...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what's up, Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I heard you and Jessica had a falling out last week...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know about that?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Puh-lease. Just because I'm not Head Cheerleader anymore doesn't mean I don't keep tabs on everything that's going on...

nodes.text: But I heard it's because you didn't want to endorse Ben.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.text: Come on, think about it... You don't want to endorse Ben because of Jessica, that much is clear.

nodes.text: Is it?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And I'm totally against both of them, so you should support me!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It'll ruin Jessica's plan entirely!

nodes.text: What do you say?

nodes.text: I'm afraid I can't.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.text: I don't know.

nodes.text: Well, good for you.

nodes.text: Wait, what? You like that I haven't decided anything?

nodes.text: No... I like that you're not rushing into a decision.

nodes.text: And both of those are terrible!

nodes.text: I know. But I think most couples just try to figure out something quickly without thinking about the consequences of their decision.

nodes.text: Well, that's definitely what I'm doing...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I wish I didn't have to think about it at all.

nodes.text: Hey, where `is` that guy? I haven't seen his mopey face around lately.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, where [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] that guy? I haven't seen his mopey face around lately.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's been prepping all week for his interview with Kingston University. It's today, right after school.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is the final interview before they decide if they're going to give him a scholarship or not.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's so nervous. Kingston is his top pick.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If he doesn't do well at this interview, he won't be able to go.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow. No pressure.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know. I hope he does well...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you sure about that? Kingston is far, far, `far` away...
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you sure about that? Kingston is far, far, [color=#3b78e2][i]far[/i][/color] away...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I don't want him to go to Kingston, but it's a good chance for him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what are you going to do if it comes down to him moving across the country?
Suddenly, it all falls into place for $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Sam! Jessica's not just going to stop with you! She's going after everyone around me!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then we're going to take her down...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... I can't...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know you said you just wanted her to leave you alone, but this is `way` over the line! You can't always be nice!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know you said you just wanted her to leave you alone, but this is [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] over the line! You can't always be nice!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's not that! If she's going after everyone I love...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's going after Howard too!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The interview!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have to get to him!
$ZOE turns away from Sam and sprints towards the makeshift library where Howard is meeting the Kingston interviewer.

Sam finds the cheerleaders at practice and storms up to Jessica...
Sam... What are you doing here?
I thought you'd for sure be making out with your 'sweet emo cakes'...
Or maybe you'd prefer to keep telling him how 'cutely dark' he is?
Shut up... Don't remind me how much I want to punch you right now...
Why would you want to do that?
Because `you're` the one that planted `my` texts on `that` website!
That website has been around for ages! I have nothing to do with it!
And you can't prove I did anything...
Can't I?
It's not my fault you `misplaced your phone.`
So `you` admit it! You took it!
Or you can look in your `backpack...` Which is where `you` probably `left it...`
Sam checks her bag and finds the phone.
Okay, fine. So you didn't get `caught`...
But this isn't over, Jessica... I'll find proof that you did this...
And you're going to regret it!
Sam leaves the park.
She hurries to swim practice, trying to collect herself...
And that's when she spots Nick and Sara talking to one another...
Ready to hear my new plan for getting my name out there?
Sure.
`Posters.`
How two-dimensional.
Ha ha... Come on... It's just as good as your button idea...
The door behind Sam closes with a slam, causing Nick to look up.
Hey, Sam...
Nick sees Sam's face.
Why do you look upset?
`Why?` Why aren't you upset at all?
Over what?
You know what!
I do?
You don't care that everything we had together is just... Broadcast to the entire freakin' world?
What are you talking about?
Just... Just get out of here... I can't talk to you right now.
Oh... Uh, okay, I'll just go then...
Nick hurries out.
...Whoa.
Don't you start.
Hey, I have no idea what you're talking about.
You didn't get a text?
I don't really have that many friends... A text about what?
Someone put all the texts between me and Nick up on a website. It's all there... For everyone to see.
Even the stupid details... How much I like this glasses... Or his skinny jeans... Or his emo hair...
I'm sorry.
To be fair, I don't think Nick knew. He would probably be just as upset, don't you think?
I don't know...
Well, he's a sensitive guy...
Really? He doesn't seem to be `that` sensitive. I mean, he does all that research on war and stuff for his newspaper articles, doesn't he?
That's different. When it comes to personal feelings... He's the most sensitive guy I know... Or the only guy, really.
Huh... You're right... I didn't see it that way...
Well, it seems like I just ruined his day. I should apologize.
I'm sure it's not that bad... He's very willing to forgive, I think.
Thanks, Sara...
No problem!
I'll apologize right after practice...
Hey... I've got some steam to blow off... Want to race?
